Name: NCA Cloud Cybersecurity Controls (CSCC-1:2019)
Description: The Cloud Cybersecurity Controls (CSCC-1:2019) framework was issued by the National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) of Saudi Arabia to establish mandatory cybersecurity controls for Cloud Service Providers (CSPs) and Cloud Service Tenants (CSTs) to securely adopt and manage cloud computing services.

Requirements.Name: CCG-1 Cloud Cybersecurity Governance
Requirements.Description: Cloud computing cybersecurity policies, governance architecture, and compliance oversight must be established and enforced across all AWS accounts.

Requirements.Name: CCD-1 Cloud Identity and Access Management
Requirements.Description: Enforce strong Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), role-based access control (RBAC), password policies, and privileged access boundaries across AWS IAM.

Requirements.Name: CCD-2 Cloud Data & Storage Protection
Requirements.Description: Protect S3 buckets, RDS databases, DynamoDB tables, and EBS volumes using KMS encryption, secure transport enforcement, and block public access settings.

Requirements.Name: CCD-3 Cloud Network & Perimeter Defense
Requirements.Description: VPCs, subnets, and security groups must be strictly configured with zero open internet ingress for administrative ports and VPC Flow Logs active.

Requirements.Name: CCD-4 Cloud Cryptographic Key Management
Requirements.Description: Centralize and protect all cryptographic keys and secrets in AWS KMS and Secrets Manager with automatic key rotation and IAM policy restrictions.

Requirements.Name: CCD-5 Cloud Threat Detection & Vulnerability Management
Requirements.Description: Enable intelligent threat detection with GuardDuty, posture assessment with Security Hub, and sensitive data discovery with Macie.

Requirements.Name: CCD-6 Cloud Logging, Auditing & SIEM Ingestion
Requirements.Description: Comprehensive CloudTrail multi-region logs and CloudWatch alarms must be configured, encrypted, and archived for security monitoring.

Requirements.Name: CCR-1 Cloud Backup, Recovery & Resilience
Requirements.Description: Implement automated AWS Backup plans and database point-in-time recovery across production workloads.
